what: On a horizontally overflowing strip, the mouse’s horizontal position ratio becomes the scroll position directly. Far left is the start, far right is the last section, the center is the middle. It follows with no curve (with the ease option, it glides after by that many seconds). On phones, you simply swipe with your finger.

options.ease: Seconds to catch up — 0 is instant (original), any value glides over that length. Default 0

from.where: detail.html .hy-thumbs (thumbnail strip below the space photos — original .space_photos_thumb mousemove: scrollLeft = (x − left) / width × (scrollWidth − width))
